MSToolkit and mzParser

MSToolkit reads mass spectrometry data for DIA-NN.
MSToolkit code is licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0 (LICENSE.txt).
Included third-party code retains its original license.

MSToolkit
Copyright 2005-2016, Michael R. Hoopmann

mzParser
Copyright (C) 2011, Mike Hoopmann, Institute for Systems Biology
The BSD terms for the mzParser reader and its RAMP interface are in
mzParser-BSD.txt. BasicSpectrum.cpp credits Mike Hoopmann, Institute for
Systems Biology, copyright (C) 2010-2012.

X! Tandem
mzParser incorporates code from X! Tandem 2010.12.01. The Artistic License
and copyright notice in saxhandler.cpp are reproduced in X-Tandem-Artistic.txt.
The mzML and mzXML reader headers acknowledge the earlier work of Patrick
Pedrioli, Institute for Systems Biology, copyright (C) 2002, and credit
Ronald Beavis and Mike Hoopmann. The mzML reader also credits Patrick
Lacasse, Brendan MacLean, Fredrik Levander and Rob Craig.

The base64 conversion code in mzp_base64.cpp comes from X! Tandem.
Copyright, The Global Proteome Machine Organization
Artistic License 1.0 (Artistic-1.0.txt)

MSNumpress
Copyright 2013 Johan Teleman
Apache License, Version 2.0 (LICENSE.txt)

zlib stream indexing (Czran.cpp, derived from zran.c)
Copyright (C) 2005 Mark Adler
The zlib license is in dependencies/zlib/LICENSE.txt.
The Expat XML parser license is in ../expat-licenses/LICENSE.txt.

Source and modifications
MSToolkit source and original reader:
https://github.com/mhoopmann/mstoolkit/tree/d6521094067c8185f957160bfeb7254889992349
The published DIA-NN source identifies modifications by Vadim Demichev in
RAMPface.cpp and saxmzmlhandler.cpp, among other MSToolkit files. For example,
the RAMP reader recognizes .mstoolkit and .mstoolkit.gz as input files.
https://github.com/vdemichev/DiaNN/tree/5598ebbbe7a5313434f4986aa24262337ce6d5b0/mstoolkit
The BSD text for RAMPface.cpp is reproduced from the MSToolkit packaging
copyright record:
https://sources.debian.org/data/main/libm/libmstoolkit/82-7.2/debian/copyright
